name: Pneumatic ATC
author: ncSender
description: Pneumatic automatic tool changer workflow helper. Uses a single aux output to clamp/unclamp the collet.

PRESSURE_FAULT.title: Air Pressure Low
PRESSURE_FAULT.message:
The air-pressure sensor is not reporting enough pressure to work the drawbar, so the tool change cannot safely continue.

Check that the compressor is running and up to pressure, the regulator is set correctly, and no line is kinked or disconnected. Once pressure is restored, click "Re-check" — the macro reads the sensor again and only carries on if it now reads good. Click "Abort" to stop the tool change.

PRESSURE_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.title: Air Pressure Still Low
PRESSURE_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.message:
Pressure has been re-checked twice and is still below what the drawbar needs.

Continuing does not mean the problem is fixed. The tool change will carry on without confirmed air pressure, which risks the drawbar not opening or closing fully — a tool can be left loose in the spindle or dropped. Only continue if you have a reason to believe the sensor is wrong rather than the air.

Click "Abort" to stop the tool change, which is the safe choice.

DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_OPEN.title: Drawbar Did Not Open
DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_OPEN.message:
The drawbar was commanded open but the drawbar sensor never reported it moving, so the tool change has stopped before relying on a release that did not happen.

The usual cause is no air: check that the compressor is running and up to pressure, the regulator is set, and no line is kinked or disconnected. Also check the solenoid and the sensor itself.

Fix the fault and click "Continue" to carry on from here, or "Abort" to stop the tool change. The sensor is not read again, so only continue once you can see the drawbar is open.

The spindle is clear of the rack so you can get to it. Continuing puts it back where it was and carries on from there.

DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_CLOSE.title: Drawbar Did Not Close
DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_CLOSE.message:
The drawbar was commanded closed but the drawbar sensor still reports it open, so the tool is not gripped. The sequence has stopped here rather than move and drop it.

Check air pressure, the solenoid, and that nothing is fouling the drawbar or the pull stud.

Support the tool before clicking anything. Click "Continue" to carry on from here, or "Abort" to stop the tool change.

The spindle is clear of the rack so you can get to it. Continuing puts it back where it was and carries on from there.

TOOL_FAILED_TO_SEAT.title: No Tool In Spindle
TOOL_FAILED_TO_SEAT.message:
The drawbar closed, but the tool sensor does not detect a tool in the spindle. The holder may be mis-seated, the slot may have been empty, or the tool did not come up with the drawbar.

Inspect the slot and the spindle taper, and seat the tool by hand if needed.

Click "Continue" to carry on from here, or "Abort" to stop the tool change. The sensor is not read again, so only continue once the tool is actually in place.

The spindle is clear of the rack so you can get to it. Continuing puts it back where it was and carries on from there.

TOOL_STILL_GRIPPED.title: Tool Did Not Release
TOOL_STILL_GRIPPED.message:
The spindle lifted away from the slot but the tool sensor still detects a tool, so the tool did not stay behind in the rack.

Check that the holder dropped cleanly into the slot and is not hung up on the cup or fork, and that the drawbar is fully open.

Click "Continue" to carry on from here, or "Abort" to stop the tool change.

FAILED_UNLOAD_TOOL.title: Unload Failed
FAILED_UNLOAD_TOOL.message: Failed to unload {toolNumber}. Please manually remove the bit, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.

FAILED_LOAD_TOOL.title: Load Failed
FAILED_LOAD_TOOL.message: Failed to load {toolNumber}. Please manually install the bit, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.

MANUAL_UNLOAD_TOOL.title: Manual Unload
MANUAL_UNLOAD_TOOL.message: Click Release to open the drawbar. Remove tool {toolNumber}, then click Continue. Or click Abort to cancel.

MANUAL_LOAD_TOOL.title: Manual Load
MANUAL_LOAD_TOOL.message: Click Release to open the drawbar. Insert tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp to close it, then click Continue.

MANUAL_CLAMP_TOOL.title: Manual Load
MANUAL_CLAMP_TOOL.message: Insert tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp to close the drawbar, then click Continue.

MANUAL_SWAP_TOOL.title: Manual Swap
MANUAL_SWAP_TOOL.message: Click Release to open the drawbar. Remove the current tool, insert tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp to close the drawbar, then click Continue.
